text: SANCTUM WALL: 584 signs, nothing scraped, four parts. (1) 128 signs of OLD writing, completely intact, the only uncensored old text we have, with crook 5 times. A formula repeats 3 times: (wave+curl box-cross)(crook box-cross)(mbox-sweep seed)(box-point seed). (2) The MIDDLE version (same text as the chapels' middle parts), still containing crook. (3) A newest-style text. (4) The middle text rewritten in the newest style, with seed → horn and wide → moon exactly as predicted, and no crook.
